_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
A nyi azɔnwá {player_id} to azɔnwá {num_players} tɔn Liar's Dice xwéxwé lɛ.
Nùkpɛ̀:
- Tɔ̀n wà nwí, a nyi sɔ̀n:
  1) Fà xwéxwé yíyí ɖò nwí ɖò azɔ̀n wà ɖì nwí ɖì tɛ̀lɛ̀, kà wàkà '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Xɔ̀ azɔ̀n wà godo tɛ̀lɛ̀ '[Call]'.

Nù a xɔ̀:
  - Nù azɔ̀n wà yíyí ɖò tɛ̀lɛ̀ wàkà xwéxwé yíyí ɖò nwí lɛ̀, azɔnwá wà godo tɛ̀lɛ̀ wàkà ɖò kùn ɖò.
  - Kà wàkà, xɔ̀wá wàkà ɖò kùn ɖò.
Azɔnwá wà ɖò kùn ɖò lɛ̀, wàkà wà xwéxwé lɛ̀.

board.new_round:
Nɔnɔ azɛ - Gbɛtɔ wɔnɔ: {dice_summary}
Azo wɔnɔ si wɔ: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Azo {current_player_id} ɖi! Nɔnɔ si face {face_value} wɔ na {count}, si na ɖɛ wɔ na {quantity}.
Azo {loser_id} (azɛ gãnu) yɔnɔ wɔnɔ.
call.caller_loses:
Azo {current_player_id} ɖi! Nɔnɔ si face {face_value} wɔ na {count}, si na >= {quantity}.
Azo {loser_id} (azɛ ɖi) yɔnɔ wɔnɔ.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: È ɖɔ xó bɔ è ma sɔ́ dó akwɛ jí ǎ.
invalid_move.invalid_bid: Akwɛ́ e è sɔ́ dó xɔ ɔ́ ná é nyí nǔtí ǎ: {reason}
invalid_move.not_recognized: Azo na ɖɛ wɔnɔ na '[Bid: X, Y]' kple '[Call]'. Azo si na: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Numɛro dɔ bid tɔn wɛkɔ wɛkɔ {new_quantity} wɛ LESS wɛ numɛro dɔ bid tɔn wɛkɔ {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: nùjɔnǔ ɔ {new_face_value} nɔ jɛji hú ée ɖò azɔ̌ jí é {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Akwɛ e è na dó ɔ́ cí ée ɖò fí din é ɖɔhun.
bid_reason.face_range: Akwɛ́ e è nɔ mɔ é ɖó na ɖò 1 jɛ 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: {player_id} è ɖè mɛ ɖó nùɖé wú ǎ.
